spec.name: Furniture Crystal Ball
spec.description: A stepped lavender scrying orb with a luminous pale-violet heart, resting on a carved dark-purple tripod stand with restrained antique-gold trim. Fourteen connected, axis-aligned cuboids fit within one block. Front faces negative Z; all cube nets are distinct and non-overlapping.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: glowing lavender crystal scrying orb made from a stepped voxel sphere on a dark purple three-footed carved stand, gold trim and luminous pale violet center. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
